runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 01:37 public-web sweep across 13 actually searched source families. No new promotion-grade unique job passed ranking and evidence gates, so jobs-data.json remains fail-closed at 52 LIVE items. Direct Welo Data surfaced Ads Quality Rater - Slovak, fully remote from Slovakia, flexible 5-20 h/week and about USD 8/h, but explicit strong written/spoken English makes it a language reject for the A2 profile. Welo Generative AI Analyst is remote Slovakia at USD 12.10/h but explicitly requires strong written English plus relevant annotation/content-review experience. Slovak Telekom Trainee DBA is fresh Bratislava and trainee-level but requires Linux/Windows database administration and scripting, so it is a hard-skill reject. Junior Business Analyst was reverified and remains rejected for analytics/English burden. Upwork surfaced worldwide customer-support/admin/e-commerce work, but strongest visible candidates were either English-heavy, low-paid, older/high-competition, or unclear on practical fit. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: English evidence normalization
developmentChanges.reason: Persist the exact source wording for language requirements and map phrases such as strong, fluent, professional or basic English to a confidence-tagged CEFR estimate. This prevents ambiguous English wording from being treated inconsistently across sources and reduces false promotions for A2 candidates.

developmentChanges.title: Side-gig schedule friction score
developmentChanges.reason: For part-time, freelance and project work, score minimum weekly hours, fixed coverage windows, weekend requirements, response-time SLA and schedule autonomy. This highlights stackable side gigs that can realistically coexist with another job instead of ranking only by hourly pay.
